title: confiture test-db prune --format json
description: The clones of one template that were dropped, reaping those leaked by crashed workers. Assembled by the command. A template with no clone left is not a failure: dropped is empty and the command exits 0.

template.description: The template database name given as --template.

dropped.description: The clone databases dropped, in pg_database order; empty if none.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
